FINAL IVX GAP-CLOSE EXECUTION
COMPLETE ALL UNDEPLOYED, NEVER-CODED, PENDING, AND OWNER-GATED ITEMS
BUILD NEW APK, DEPLOY, TEST, AND RETURN LIVE PROOF

EXECUTE NOW.

DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER GENERAL AUDIT.
DO NOT REPEAT COMPLETED ITEMS.
DO NOT CLAIM PASS FROM SOURCE INSPECTION.
DO NOT MARK 100% UNTIL THE NEW APK IS BUILT, INSTALLED, AND VERIFIED.

CURRENT VERIFIED GAP AUDIT

GROUP A — CODE EXISTS BUT IS NOT IN LIVE APK:
1. QueryClient cache/default improvements
2. DealVideoCard migrated to expo-image
3. HoldingCard migrated to expo-image
4. TrustDealCard migrated to expo-image

GROUP B — PREVIOUSLY CLAIMED BUT NEVER CODED:
5. Home skeleton loading
6. CRM skeleton loading
7. Remove hardcoded colors from Invest
8. Remove hardcoded colors from Profit/Loss

GROUP C — PLANNED BUT NEVER STARTED:
9. IVX IA Chat branding
10. Business and document branding
11. App Factory brand inheritance

GROUP D — OWNER/ENVIRONMENT VALIDATION:
12. Custom SMTP
13. Cross-browser and physical-device QA
14. Real 60-minute Reels soak test and memory profiling

OBJECTIVE

Complete all code-level gaps.
Build one new production APK containing every mobile fix.
Deploy all backend and landing changes.
Verify production parity.
Run real-device QA honestly.
Return evidence for every item.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — FREEZE BASELINE
==================================================

Before changing code, record:

- repository
- branch
- GitHub HEAD
- Render runtime SHA
- current APK version
- current versionCode
- current APK SHA-256
- current APK URL
- current landing ETag
- current test counts
- current open gaps

Return:

BASELINE_GITHUB_SHA:
BASELINE_RUNTIME_SHA:
CURRENT_APK:
CURRENT_VERSION:
CURRENT_VERSION_CODE:
CURRENT_APK_SHA256:
CURRENT_TESTS:
OPEN_GAPS: 14

Create a dedicated execution checklist with exactly 14 numbered items.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — SHIP GROUP A INTO THE NEW APK
==================================================

Verify and finish these existing code changes:

1. QueryClient defaults
File:
expo/app/_layout.tsx

Required:

- one QueryClient instance
- staleTime configured
- gcTime configured
- bounded retry
- refetchOnReconnect enabled
- refetchOnWindowFocus appropriate for mobile
- no QueryClient recreation on render
- no spinner flashes caused by zero cache defaults

Add tests for:

- cache survives route changes
- reconnect triggers refresh
- duplicate fetches are deduplicated
- stale data remains visible during refresh

2. DealVideoCard → expo-image
File:
expo/components/DealVideoCard.tsx

Required:

- expo-image used
- memory-disk cache
- transition/fade configured
- fixed aspect ratio
- fallback image
- load error isolation
- no layout shift
- no unbounded full-resolution image retention

3. HoldingCard → expo-image
File:
expo/components/HoldingCard.tsx

Apply the same requirements.

4. TrustDealCard → expo-image
File:
expo/components/TrustDealCard.tsx

Apply the same requirements.

Do not consider these complete until they are proven inside the newly built APK.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — IMPLEMENT HOME SKELETONS
==================================================

Implement the Home loading experience that was previously claimed but never coded.

Required shared components:

- HomeHeaderSkeleton
- HeroSkeleton
- DealCardSkeleton
- MetricCardSkeleton
- ReelPreviewSkeleton
- NotificationSkeleton

Behavior:

- cached content appears immediately
- skeletons show only when no cache exists
- skeleton dimensions match final content
- no full-screen spinner
- no blank page
- no layout jump
- background refresh keeps old content visible
- partial API failures do not hide successful sections

Audit Home route and every child section.

Required states:

IDLE
LOADING_INITIAL
SHOWING_CACHE
REFRESHING
SUCCESS
EMPTY
PARTIAL_ERROR
FATAL_ERROR

Add tests for all states.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — IMPLEMENT CRM SKELETONS
==================================================

Implement CRM loading behavior.

Required skeletons:

- CRMHeaderSkeleton
- CRMStatsSkeleton
- CRMLeadRowSkeleton
- CRMFilterSkeleton
- CRMPipelineSkeleton

Behavior:

- cached first page renders immediately
- loading more uses footer loader only
- search does not clear existing rows
- filters preserve current content until response arrives
- no spinner loop
- no list flash
- scroll position preserved
- malformed row isolated

Test:

- empty CRM
- 1 row
- 100 rows
- pagination
- slow network
- offline/reconnect
- failed next page
- stale cache

==================================================
PHASE 5 — REMOVE HARDCODED COLORS FROM INVEST
==================================================

Audit all Invest screens and components.

Find and replace hardcoded color literals such as:

- #000000
- #FFFFFF
- #FFD700
- #F5E9EB
- rgba literals
- direct hex values in inline styles

Use one official IVX design-token source.

Required tokens:

- backgroundPrimary
- backgroundSecondary
- surface
- surfaceElevated
- border
- textPrimary
- textSecondary
- goldPrimary
- goldPressed
- success
- warning
- danger
- info
- overlay

All Invest screens must consume tokens.

Do not create duplicate theme files.

Verify:

- dark mode consistency
- disabled states
- pressed states
- error states
- loading states
- accessibility contrast

Return exact hardcoded-color count before and after.

Target:

production Invest hardcoded-color count = 0
except documented third-party or test fixtures.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — REMOVE HARDCODED COLORS FROM PROFIT/LOSS
==================================================

Repeat the same audit for Profit/Loss.

Verify:

- positive values
- negative values
- zero values
- chart labels
- cards
- filters
- tabs
- loading states
- empty states
- error states

Use semantic tokens:

profit
loss
neutral
warning

Do not use raw green/red values in component code.

Return exact count before and after.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — IVX IA CHAT BRANDING
==================================================

Complete official IVX branding in IVX IA Chat.

Required:

- official IVX logo
- official IVX symbol
- official typography
- official gold/black tokens
- no Rork branding
- no Rork names
- no old placeholders
- no mixed logo versions
- consistent header
- consistent task cards
- consistent error cards
- consistent proof cards
- consistent loading states
- consistent empty state
- consistent attachment icons
- consistent owner-control badges

Search for:

rork
Rork
placeholder
old logo filenames
legacy accent colors
temporary branding

Remove runtime-visible references.

Historical comments may remain only when necessary and must not appear in UI.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — BUSINESS AND DOCUMENT BRANDING
==================================================

Apply IVX branding to:

- PDF headers
- PDF footers
- exported reports
- investor summaries
- deal summaries
- member documents
- email templates
- notification templates
- share cards
- social preview images
- downloadable CSV/XLSX labels
- business cards if generated
- receipts
- statements
- owner reports

Required brand fields:

- IVX logo
- IVX Holdings name
- official domain
- official support email
- official legal footer
- generated timestamp
- document ID
- confidentiality label where appropriate

Do not place secrets or internal IDs in public documents.

Verify generated files visually and by asset hash where possible.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — APP FACTORY BRAND INHERITANCE
==================================================

The App Factory must create new IVX-owned apps/modules with IVX branding by default.

Required factory manifest fields:

- companyName
- appName
- bundleId
- packageName
- logoAsset
- faviconAsset
- primaryColorToken
- secondaryColorToken
- typographyToken
- legalName
- supportEmail
- privacyURL
- termsURL

Default behavior:

- never use Rork logo
- never use Rork package name
- never use Rork bundle ID
- never use Rork URLs
- never use placeholder branding
- new apps inherit official IVX assets
- owner can override branding through approved configuration

Create one factory-generated test module/app in an isolated sample path.

Verify:

- correct logo
- correct package/bundle identifiers
- correct theme
- no Rork dependency
- no Rork UI string
- no runtime call to Rork

Do not publish the test app to production unless explicitly approved.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — VERSION BUMP AND BUILD PREPARATION
==================================================

Bump the mobile version.

Current reported APK:
v1.4.35
versionCode 67

Create the next valid production version.

Example:

version: 1.4.36
versionCode: 68

Use the actual next unused values.

Verify consistency across:

- app.config.ts
- app.json if present
- Android Gradle config
- package metadata
- release marker
- About screen
- health/version endpoint if applicable

Do not reuse an existing versionCode.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — FULL AUTOMATED QA
==================================================

Run targeted tests for each completed item.

Required:

GROUP A:
- QueryClient tests
- image component tests
- fallback tests
- cache tests

GROUP B:
- Home skeleton tests
- CRM skeleton tests
- theme-token tests
- hardcoded-color scan

GROUP C:
- branding asset tests
- no-Rork UI scan
- factory branding inheritance tests
- document/export branding tests

Run:

- unit tests
- integration tests
- component render tests
- API contract tests
- TypeScript
- lint
- asset integrity tests
- secret scan
- Rork runtime-reference scan
- production smoke tests

Return:

TEST_FILES:
TESTS_PASSED:
TESTS_FAILED:
TESTS_SKIPPED:
TSC_ERRORS:
LINT_ERRORS:
HARDCODED_COLORS_REMAINING:
RORK_RUNTIME_REFERENCES:

Do not hide skipped tests.

==================================================
PHASE 12 — BUILD NEW APK
==================================================

Build a clean Android production APK containing all mobile code changes.

Requirements:

- clean dependency install
- clean Gradle build
- production environment
- no development server dependency
- no Expo Go dependency
- no Rork SDK
- no Rork Metro wrapper
- correct IVX package name
- correct IVX icon
- correct splash
- correct version/versionCode
- signed build
- installable APK

Return:

APK_FILENAME:
VERSION:
VERSION_CODE:
PACKAGE_NAME:
FILE_SIZE:
SHA256:
BUILD_COMMAND:
BUILD_RESULT:

The APK must be different from v1.4.35 and must include the four Group A changes plus Groups B and C mobile changes.

==================================================
PHASE 13 — APK UPLOAD AND DISTRIBUTION
==================================================

Upload the APK to the owner-controlled IVX distribution path.

Verify:

- HTTP 200
- exact Content-Length
- exact SHA-256
- ETag
- no stale APK
- direct installation works
- filename reflects the actual version
- old APK remains available only if required for rollback

Return the exact production APK URL.

Owner approval required:

CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD

==================================================
PHASE 14 — BACKEND AND LANDING DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

If backend or landing files changed:

1. Commit related files.
2. Deploy backend.
3. Upload landing assets.
4. Invalidate CloudFront.
5. Wait for completion.
6. Verify ETags/checksums.
7. Verify GitHub HEAD equals runtime SHA.

Owner approvals:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY
CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATION

Return:

GITHUB_SHA:
RENDER_DEPLOY_ID:
RUNTIME_SHA:
COMMIT_PARITY:
CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATION_ID:
LANDING_ETAG:

==================================================
PHASE 15 — SMTP CLOSEOUT
==================================================

First verify whether SMTP credentials already exist in stored owner variables or Supabase configuration.

Do not ask for credentials unless verified missing.

If credentials exist:

- bind them
- configure Supabase Auth SMTP
- verify sender
- verify SPF
- verify DKIM
- verify DMARC
- send confirmation email
- send password-reset email
- verify receipt

If verified missing:

Return exact owner action:

- provider
- host
- port
- username
- sender address
- sender domain
- DNS records required

Do not expose password values.

SMTP remains BLOCKED only if verified missing.

==================================================
PHASE 16 — REAL DEVICE QA
==================================================

Install the new APK on a physical Android device.

Run:

1. Clean install.
2. Cold start.
3. Warm start.
4. Home loading with empty cache.
5. Home loading with cache.
6. CRM loading with empty cache.
7. CRM loading with cache.
8. Invest visual token review.
9. Profit/Loss visual token review.
10. IVX IA Chat branding review.
11. Background/foreground.
12. Network off/on.
13. App restart.
14. Session restore.
15. Deal-card image caching.
16. Image failure fallback.
17. Scroll for 15 minutes.
18. Open each major tab.
19. Confirm no mixed branding.
20. Confirm no full-screen spinner loops.

Capture screenshots and timestamps.

Also test:

- Samsung Browser
- Android Chrome
- iPhone Safari where available
- desktop Chrome
- desktop Safari where available

If unavailable, mark NOT RUN honestly and provide owner test instructions.

==================================================
PHASE 17 — REAL REELS SOAK TEST
==================================================

Run on physical Android using the new APK.

Required:

- 60 minutes continuous use
- at least 200 reel transitions
- 50 open/close cycles
- 25 comments-sheet open/close cycles
- background/foreground
- Wi-Fi off/on
- cellular/Wi-Fi switch
- pause/resume
- mute/unmute
- rapid swipe
- reverse swipe
- app restart and return to Reels

Measure:

- crash count
- JS errors
- native errors
- peak memory
- final memory
- active player count
- listener count
- timer count
- duplicate video count
- frozen player count
- black frame count
- recovery time after reconnect

Acceptance:

- zero crash
- active players bounded
- memory stabilizes
- no endless growth
- no duplicate videos
- no frozen player
- no endless spinner

Do not substitute code-level simulation for this physical-device soak test.

==================================================
PHASE 18 — MODULE VISUAL CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Verify the new APK visually for:

- Home
- Invest
- Market
- Portfolio
- Reels
- Chat
- Profile
- CRM
- JV Deal Management
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Settings
- Variables
- Profit/Loss
- Documents
- Reports

For each module return:

PASS / FAIL

Check:

- official logo
- official colors
- no loading flash
- no blank state
- no NaN
- no stale data
- no mixed branding
- no clipped text
- no keyboard overlap
- no crash

==================================================
PHASE 19 — PRODUCTION PARITY
==================================================

Verify:

GitHub HEAD
=
Render runtime SHA
=
release evidence SHA

For mobile, verify:

APK source commit
=
documented GitHub commit

Return:

GITHUB_HEAD:
RENDER_RUNTIME:
APK_SOURCE_COMMIT:
BACKEND_MATCH:
APK_MATCH:
LANDING_ASSET_MATCH:

==================================================
PHASE 20 — FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do not certify until:

[ ] All four Group A changes are in the new APK.
[ ] Home skeletons are implemented.
[ ] CRM skeletons are implemented.
[ ] Invest hardcoded colors are removed.
[ ] Profit/Loss hardcoded colors are removed.
[ ] IVX IA Chat branding is complete.
[ ] Business/document branding is complete.
[ ] App Factory brand inheritance is complete.
[ ] New APK built successfully.
[ ] New APK uploaded successfully.
[ ] New APK installed on Android.
[ ] Real-device screenshots captured.
[ ] Reels 60-minute soak test passes.
[ ] No critical test failures.
[ ] No Rork runtime branding/dependency remains.
[ ] GitHub/runtime parity is true.
[ ] SMTP is configured or honestly blocked by verified missing owner infrastructure.
[ ] Device/browser QA is honestly recorded.

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

OVERALL STATUS:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

GROUP A — IN NEW APK:
1. QueryClient:
2. DealVideoCard:
3. HoldingCard:
4. TrustDealCard:

FINAL VERDICT:

IVX PENDING CODE, UI, BRANDING, APK, DEVICE QA, AND REELS STABILITY WORK
COMPLETE, DEPLOYED, INSTALLED, AND LIVE VERIFIED

or

PARTIAL — list the exact numbered unfinished item, file, function, blocker, owner action, trace ID, and evidence.

Do not claim 100% if the new APK was not built and installed.
Do not claim Reels PASS without the physical 60-minute test.
Do not claim SMTP PASS without real email delivery.
